notes.title: Bad Mojo was one of the grossest games ever made
notes.notes: From 2010 to 2014 Richard Cobbett wrote Crapshoot, a column about rolling the dice to bring random games back into the light. This week, a game that... wait a minute, are you eating? Yeah. You might want to put it down for a while. Just a thought. And animal lovers? Push it far away... Read more.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Bad Mojo: Redux
notes.notes:
Bad Mojo: Redux is Now Available on Steam!

Enter a world of perilous puzzles and bizarre perspectives--as a cockroach. What you discover may shock you. What you don't may kill you. Either way, you won't come out the same person. You may not even come out a person at all.
